use: plantAt: place each plant at those places (one floor plant at most). foreground: the near-camera piece of the shots. groups: build every listed group (a few pieces under one group name, at the place named) and make each the subject of one tour shot; the hero group counts as the first. Soft things: a.seatSoft(id, { tone }), a.table(id, { cloth: true }). still: put each thing on its top with a.onTop; wallArr: hang it on the longest bare wall stretch. side: the hero group sits on that side of the home view. See compose.mjs. motion: a.alive(roll.areas[id].motion) in the spec; see src/motion/index.js.

kitchen.say: kitchen: range hood over the hob; one backing wall; window on the back wall; accents: fruit bowl, wall shelf with jars, herbs on the worktop, stool, utensil crock beside the hob (utensilCrock); plants: herbs or a pot on the worktop; a hanging plant from a rail or hook; a pot on a window sill; still life: the worktop beside the hob holds utensil crock beside the hob (utensilCrock) and moka pot (mokaPot); the breakfast table holds mug (mug) and salt and pepper (saltPepper); wall arrangement: open shelf with plates and jars (openShelf); hero group on the left of the home view; foreground piece: step stool; light: pendant; cutting board: flat on the worktop with a loaf, knife and a few vegetables on it; above the run: wall units over the run (wallRun); accent (rust) on the runner; pieces: as the hero needs; signs of life: table runner, tablecloth
